headline: BIL Vyapar Limited: Fifteenth Meeting of Committee of Creditors in CIRP
sum: BIL Vyapar Limited has convened the fifteenth meeting of its Committee of Creditors under the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process, indicating ongoing creditor engagement in the resolution proceedings.
detail: BIL Vyapar Limited, an industrial entity, is undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process initiated under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The company has notified the National Stock Exchange of the convening of its fifteenth Committee of Creditors meeting, a procedural step required under IBC s. 27 for creditor-overseen approval of resolution plans and material decisions. The fifteenth meeting indicates this CIRP has progressed through multiple rounds of creditor deliberation, suggesting complexity in plan evaluation or asset realisation.
